approval_evidence.quote: 11/10/2015 ORIG-1 Approval (Drugs@FDA, Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals)

series_start_reason: Roche's FY2015 investor update (28 Jan 2016) prints the first Cotellic sales (full year 2); the nine-month 2015 release (med-cor-2015-10-22-e.pdf) mentions Cotellic only in regulatory text and prints no sales row, and FDA approval was 10 Nov 2015, so the full-year figure is read as 2015Q4. This is an inference from the absence of earlier rows.
notes: Printed line is 'Cotellic'; worldwide Total column. Roche prints Cotellic in year-to-date tables only (Top-selling/Recent new launches and later Product sales tables) and never in the quarterly Top 20 table, so Q2 to Q4 of every year are year-to-date differences and Q1 of each year is the three-month table. launch_quarter left null because no Roche document read states a launch quarter (FDA approval 10 Nov 2015).
search_log: reused the earlier Roche crawl (roche.com/investors/events/{q1,hy,q3,annual-results}-YYYY, 2016-2026) and its downloaded Investor update PDFs, plus the assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf results releases for 2011-2015 found by dated probing; 63 results releases from the FY2010 release (2011-02-02) to the half-year 2026 release (2026-07-23) were read as text

per release read two tables: the worldwide 'Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales' table (five quarter columns, Total table that precedes the United States/Europe/Japan/International tables) and the year-to-date product sales table (Total, United States, Europe, Japan, International); quarters taken from the own release quarter column when printed, else the Q1 year-to-date table (three months), else the earliest later release that prints the quarter, else year-to-date differences

wherever both a printed quarter and a year-to-date difference existed they were compared: no difference found; for every calendar year whose four quarters are in the series the sum equals the full-year (January-December) figure of that year's FY release
Roche half-year/annual reports and Finance Reports, and the 2009-2010 quarterly results releases, were not retrieved or used for rows; Chugai/Genentech documents were not used
Cotellic absence before FY2015: med-cor-2015-10-22-e.pdf (nine-month 2015) mentions Cotellic only in text and prints no sales row
